section.content: 本申请公开了一种生物基因用PCR基因扩增仪，其包括扩增仪外壳、扩增槽、卡槽、加热片、盖板和样品槽，卡槽的一侧上设置有多个进风管，多个进风管共同连通有通风设备，样品槽底壁上开设有多个通孔，多个进风管远离通风设备的一端分别与多个通孔连通，通孔远离进风管的一端连通有出风管，通孔内设置有用于使得样品槽快速制冷的制冷机构。本申请具有通风设备对多个进风管通入一定温度的冷风，使得多个进风管中的冷风通入到通孔中，使得样品槽的底壁上流通有冷风，冷风配合制冷机构共同对样品槽的底壁进行快速降温，使得样品槽的温度能够在比较短的时间内降到一定的温度，从而便于随样品进行取样检测的效果。

The application discloses PCR gene amplification instrument for biological gene, it is including augmenting the appearance shell, amplify the groove, the draw-in groove, the heating plate, apron and sample groove, be provided with a plurality of air-supply lines on one side of draw-in groove, a plurality of air-supply lines communicate jointly has ventilation equipment, a plurality of through-holes have been seted up on the sample groove diapire, the one end that ventilation equipment was kept away from to a plurality of air-supply lines communicates with a plurality of through-holes respectively, the one end intercommunication that the air-supply line was kept away from to the through-hole has the tuber pipe, be provided with in the through-hole and be used for making the quick refrigerated refrigeration mechanism of sample groove. This application has ventilation equipment and lets in the cold wind of uniform temperature to a plurality of air-supply lines for during cold wind among a plurality of air-supply lines lets in the through-hole, make the circulation have cold wind on the diapire of sample cell, cold wind cooperation refrigeration mechanism carries out rapid cooling to the diapire of sample cell jointly, makes the temperature of sample cell can fall to certain temperature in than short time, thereby is convenient for carry out the effect of sample detection along with the sample.

PCR gene amplification instrument for biological geneTechnical Field

The application relates to the field of biological amplification, in particular to a PCR gene amplification instrument for biological genes.

Background

PCR, polymerase chain reaction, also called cell-free molecular cloning or specific DNA sequence in vitro primer directional enzymatic amplification technology, is a method for synthesizing specific DNA fragment in vitro enzymatic, and is formed into a cycle by high temperature denaturation, low temperature annealing, suitable temperature extension and other steps of reaction, and is circularly carried out, so that the target DNA can be rapidly amplified, and the method has the characteristics of strong specificity, high sensitivity, simple and convenient operation, time saving and the like; the PCR amplifier is an instrument for amplifying specific DNA by using PCR (polymerase chain reaction), and is widely used in medical and biological laboratories.

Chinese patent with application number CN202021575673.7 in the related technology provides a novel PCR gene amplification instrument, which comprises an amplification instrument shell, a control panel, a liquid crystal display screen, a control button, a loudspeaker, a switch, an amplification groove, a clamping groove, a heating sheet, a cover plate, a sample groove, a back plate and a storage battery.

With respect to the related art among the above, the inventors consider that the following drawbacks exist: when stopping heating to the heating plate to when making the heating plate cool down, hardly make the temperature on the heating plate transmit the sample that makes in the sample cell fast cooling to the sample cell fast, thereby hardly guarantee that the sample controls the uniform temperature in the short time, thereby probably influence the best period that the sample detected.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

In order to solve the problem that the sample in a sample tank is difficult to be rapidly cooled to ensure that the sample is controlled to a certain temperature in a short time, the application provides a PCR gene amplification instrument for biological genes.

The PCR gene amplification instrument for the biological gene adopts the following technical scheme:

the utility model provides a PCR gene amplification appearance for biological gene, includes amplification appearance shell, amplification groove, draw-in groove, heating plate, apron and sample groove, be provided with a plurality of air-supply lines on one side of draw-in groove, it is a plurality of the common intercommunication of air-supply line has ventilation equipment, a plurality of through-holes have been seted up on the sample groove diapire, it is a plurality of the air-supply line is kept away from ventilation equipment's one end respectively with a plurality of the through-hole intercommunication, the through-hole is kept away from the one end intercommunication of air-supply line has a tuber pipe, be provided with in the through-hole and be used for making the sample groove is the refrigerated refrigeration mechanism of heat transfer fast.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, when the sample of needs in to the sample cell is cooled down, let in the cold wind of uniform temperature to a plurality of air-supply lines through ventilation equipment, make the cold wind among a plurality of air-supply lines let in the through-hole, it has cold wind to make to flow on the diapire of sample cell, cold wind is cooperating the common diapire to the sample cell of refrigeration mechanism simultaneously again and is carrying out rapid cooling, make the temperature of sample cell can fall to certain temperature value in than short time, thereby be convenient for carry out sample detection along with the sample.

Optionally, refrigeration mechanism includes the refrigeration strip, the sample cell in the through-hole is along the equal fixedly connected with joint plate in its length direction's both sides, refrigeration strip joint is in two between the joint plate, the refrigeration strip is close to one side of sample cell diapire with the sample cell is laminated mutually, the joint plate with be provided with between the refrigeration strip and be used for with the refrigeration strip is fixed subassembly between the joint plate.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, will refrigerate the strip through fixed subassembly and fix between two joint boards for the laminating of refrigeration strip is on the diapire of sample cell, after letting in cold wind in the through-hole, makes the refrigeration strip can cool down rapidly, thereby makes the refrigeration strip can be in same temperature with the temperature of cold wind, has certain heat conduction effect to the sample cell through the refrigeration strip, helps accelerating the cooling speed of sample cell, makes the sample can be quick fall corresponding temperature.

Optionally, fixed subassembly includes a plurality of magnetic sheets and a plurality of iron sheet, and is a plurality of iron sheet fixed connection respectively is in refrigeration strip is along its length direction's both sides, and is a plurality of the magnetic sheet fixed connection respectively is two on the joint board, and is a plurality of the magnetic sheet respectively with a plurality of the iron sheet one-to-one, the magnetic sheet with iron sheet magnetism actuation.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, will refrigerate between the joint board of the both sides of strip joint income through-hole for magnetic sheet and iron sheet actuation are connected, thereby make the refrigeration strip fix between two joint boards and make the refrigeration strip laminating at the diapire of sample cell, make the refrigeration strip can have the heat conduction effect of preferred.

Optionally, a filter screen is arranged at the air outlet of the air inlet pipe, and a locking piece used for fixing the filter screen on the air inlet pipe is arranged on the air inlet pipe.

By adopting the technical scheme, the filter screen is fixed on the air inlet pipe by the locking piece, so that the situation that dust in the air is blown into the gene amplification instrument in the process of introducing cold air is avoided as much as possible, and the situation that a sample is interfered when gene amplification is carried out is avoided as much as possible.

Optionally, a plurality of placing grooves are formed in the sample groove, and the sample vessel is in clamping fit with the placing grooves.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, place the sample in the standing groove, be convenient for carry out gene amplification to the sample, it is comparatively convenient when placing and taking the sample.

Optionally, an elastic abutting ring is arranged on the inner side wall of the placing groove in a surrounding mode.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, when placing the sample in the standing groove, carry out elasticity through elasticity support ring and support tightly to the sample, avoid the sample household utensils to take place to rock when placing in the sample groove as far as possible, and then help improving the stability of sample in the sample groove, be convenient for carry out gene amplification to the sample.

Optionally, the refrigeration strip is a silicon steel strip.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, the silicon steel strip has better heat conductivity, lets in during the cold wind in the through-hole for the silicon steel strip can cool down rapidly, thereby can carry out quick heat transfer to the sample cell effectively, thereby realizes the rapid cooling of sample cell.

Optionally, the cover plate is transparent.

By adopting the technical scheme, whether the whole amplification process of the sample in the sample tank normally operates or not can be conveniently observed.

In summary, the present application includes at least one of the following beneficial technical effects:

1. through the arrangement of the air inlet pipes, the ventilation equipment, the through holes, the air outlet pipes and the refrigeration mechanism, the ventilation equipment introduces cold air with a certain temperature into the air inlet pipes, so that the cold air in the air inlet pipes is introduced into the through holes, the cold air is introduced into the bottom wall of the sample tank, and the cold air is matched with the common refrigeration mechanism to rapidly cool the bottom wall of the sample tank, so that the whole sample tank can be cooled to a certain temperature within a relatively short time, and sampling observation along with a sample is facilitated;

2. by arranging the refrigeration strip, the clamping plates and the fixing assembly, the refrigeration strip is fixed between the two clamping plates by the fixing assembly, so that the refrigeration strip is attached to the bottom wall of the sample tank, and after cold air is introduced into the through hole, the refrigeration strip can be rapidly cooled, so that the refrigeration strip and the cold air can be at the same temperature;

3. through setting up filter screen and lock piece, the lock piece is fixed the filter screen on the tuber pipe, avoids blowing into the gene amplification appearance with the dust in the air in-process as far as possible letting in cold wind, avoids the sample to receive the interference when carrying out gene amplification as far as possible.

Detailed Description

The present application is described in further detail below with reference to figures 1-4.

The embodiment of the application discloses a PCR gene amplification instrument for biological genes. Referring to fig. 1 and 2, the PCR gene amplification instrument for biological genes comprises an amplification instrument shell 1, an amplification tank 2, a clamping groove 3, a heating sheet, a cover plate 4 and a sample tank 5, wherein a plurality of air inlet pipes 6 are arranged on one side of the clamping groove 3, the air inlet pipes 6 are jointly bolted with a communicating pipe, the communicating pipe is communicated with a ventilation device, the ventilation device is a cold air blower, and the cold air blower is fixedly connected in the amplification instrument shell 1 so as to conveniently introduce cold air into the air inlet pipes 6; in order to make the air inlet pipe 6 have a certain dustproof effect, in the embodiment of the present application, a filter screen 13 is disposed at the air outlet of the air inlet pipe 6, and a locking member 14 for fixing the filter screen 13 on the air inlet pipe 6 is disposed on the air inlet pipe 6.

In one possible embodiment, the locking element 14 is provided as a soft wire, by means of which the filter screen 13 is fixedly tied to the air inlet duct 6;

in another possible embodiment, referring to fig. 2 and 4, the locking member 14 is provided with a plurality of locking bolts, and the plurality of locking bolts jointly penetrate through the filter screen 13 and are screwed on the air inlet pipe 6.

In the embodiment of the present application, the second embodiment is selected, and the filter screen 13 is fixed at the air outlet of the air inlet pipe 6 by the locking bolt, so that dust in the air is prevented from entering the PCR gene amplification apparatus as much as possible, and the sample can be amplified in an environment with high sanitary conditions during amplification.

In this application embodiment, refer to fig. 2, a plurality of through-holes 7 have been seted up on the 5 diapalls of sample groove, the one end that the air-cooler was kept away from to a plurality of air-supply lines 6 communicates with a plurality of through-holes 7 respectively, the one end intercommunication that air-supply line 6 was kept away from to through-hole 7 has a tuber pipe 8, it has the ventilation pipe to go out tuber pipe 8 to connect jointly, make cold wind flow into again from the ventilation pipe outflow in the PCR gene amplification appearance, make cold wind form constantly to encircle and pass PCR gene amplification appearance, help realizing rapid cooling to sample groove 5, be provided with in the through-hole 7 and be used for making the refrigeration mechanism of sample groove 5 rapid cooling.

Refer to fig. 2 and, fig. 3, refrigerating mechanism includes refrigeration strip 9, refrigeration strip 9 can set up to the silicon steel strip, refrigeration strip 9 can also set up to the aluminium foil strip, in this application embodiment, select first embodiment, the silicon steel strip has better heat conductivility, sample groove 5 has all welded joint board 10 in through-hole 7 along its length direction's both sides, joint board 10 is seted up flutedly in the one side that is close to each other, one side that the recess is close to the diapire of sample groove 5 is the through setting, refrigeration strip 9 joint is relative between two recesses, refrigeration strip 9 is close to one side of sample groove 5 diapire simultaneously and is laminated with sample groove 5 mutually, be provided with between joint board 10 and the refrigeration strip 9 and be used for fixing the fixed subassembly between joint board 10 with refrigeration strip 9.

Referring to fig. 3, the fixing assembly includes two magnetic sheets 11 and two iron sheets 12, the two iron sheets 12 are respectively fixedly connected to two sides of the refrigeration strip 9 along the length direction thereof, the two magnetic sheets 11 are respectively fixedly connected to the bottom walls of the two grooves, the two magnetic sheets 11 are respectively in one-to-one correspondence with the two iron sheets 12, and the magnetic sheets 11 and the iron sheets 12 are magnetically attracted.

In this application embodiment, will refrigerate 9 joints between two recesses for iron sheet 12 on the refrigeration strip 9 and the magnetic sheet 11 in the recess are inhaled mutually and are closed and be connected, make the fixed laminating of refrigeration strip 9 on the diapire of sample cell 5, thereby make refrigeration strip 9 can fix on the diapire of sample cell 5, be convenient for refrigerate strip 9 have better heat conduction effect to sample cell 5.

Generally, a sample is directly placed in the sample tank 5, so that the sample is prone to shaking in the sample tank 5, in order to stably place the sample in the sample tank 5, in the embodiment of the present application, referring to fig. 2, a plurality of placing grooves 15 are formed in the sample tank 5, a sample vessel is in clamping fit with the placing grooves 15, the shapes of the placing grooves 15 can be set according to the shapes of the sample, in the embodiment of the present application, the placing grooves 15 are set to be cylindrical, elastic abutting rings 16 are arranged around the side walls of the placing grooves 15, the elastic abutting rings 16 are set to be elastic rubber rings, and the sample vessel is elastically abutted in the placing grooves 15; be convenient for carry out gene amplification to the sample, it is comparatively convenient when placing and taking the sample, avoid the sample to take place to rock when placing in sample groove 5 as far as possible simultaneously, help the firm sample household utensils.

In order to facilitate observation of the gene amplification condition of the sample, in the embodiment of the present application, referring to fig. 1, the cover plate 4 is made of transparent glass, so that the cover plate 4 is transparent, and the worker can observe the sample conveniently and can know clearly whether the sample is normally performed in the gene amplification process.

The implementation principle of the PCR gene amplification instrument for the biological gene in the embodiment of the application is as follows: when the sample in the sample groove 5 is cooled down as required, let in the cold wind of uniform temperature to a plurality of air-supply lines 6 through the air-cooler, make the cold wind among a plurality of air-supply lines 6 let in through-hole 7, it has cold wind to make to flow on the diapire of sample groove 5, make the refrigeration strip 9 in through-hole 7 can cool down rapidly when receiving the cold wind, cold wind cooperates refrigeration strip 9 simultaneously jointly and carries out rapid cooling to the diapire of sample groove 5, make each position of temperature transfer to sample groove 5 that reduces, make the holistic temperature of sample groove 5 can fall certain temperature in the time of comparison weak point, thereby be convenient for carry out the sample detection along with the sample.

The above are preferred embodiments of the present application, and the scope of protection of the present application is not limited thereto, so: all equivalent changes made according to the structure, shape and principle of the present application shall be covered by the protection scope of the present application.
